name: Murase You
source:
Star Sign: Scorpio
Special Skill/Hobby: Fishing, Reading, Solving Rubik's Cubes
Favorite Food: Miso Soup
Disliked Food: Strawberry Daifuku

A member of CUE and a researcher in the S.A.D.F.
He's a former student of the high school the protagonist graduated from and he used to be a special lecturer there.
A guy who talks bluntly without meaning anything bad, but he often gets misunderstood.
He's childhood friends with [url=/c40228]Takumi[/url].
